item.title: Prime Night ~Joshi Ana Hakusho~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Telluru
  • 発売日: 1999-11-27
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: プライムナイト ～女子アナ白書～
  • 英語名: Prime Night Joshi Ana Hakusho

あらすじ

JBS channel popular caster Satoko Kondo is pursued by stalker lately. Pictures are sent to her office and home. She hires a detective who happens to be main character, but opponent cleverly escapes the traps. At the same time a female colleague of Satoko tries to seduce the detective. Can hero avoid the trap himself or is it possible to play the cards right to approach mystery revelation?

item.title: BMP: Go Go West!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Telluru
  • 発売日: 1999-08-06
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: BMP・GO GO WEST！
  • 英語名: BMP: Go Go West!

别名

  • B.M.P. GO GO WEST!

あらすじ

A country of women supremacy.

Takanobu Takami, a high priest monk, went on a journey with a precious scripture that is supposed to contain the secret how to return the power to men. Main heroine who used to be a man in the past, stumbles upon this monk and agrees to accompany him. But the rumor of the threat from the scripture spreads out and travelers are being hunted by aggressive women.
